settings.subheading: Every blade leaves our California forge with hundreds of folded layers of high-carbon Damascus steel, an individually contoured natural handle, and an edge proven at the anvil.

settings.title: Four Halls of the Atelier
settings.copy: From EDC pocket carriers to heavy full-tang hunting knives — every piece is forged, acid-etched and honed by hand.

settings.title: Patterns Forged in Fire & Acid
settings.copy: The mesmerizing water wave patterns on our blades are not laser-printed or coated. They are the physical topography of two dissimilar steels folded, beaten, and etched by hand.

settings.title: Most Coveted Hand-Forged Blades
settings.copy: The pieces our collectors reach for first — each billet folded, ground and heat-treated by hand.

settings.title: Forged Slow, Carried Forever
settings.copy: A White Hills blade is not stamped from rolled industrial sheet. It is folded, hammered, cryogenic quenched, and acid-etched until the steel reveals the ancient water pattern Damascus was revered for.

settings.title: The Damascus Steel Care Protocol
settings.copy: High-carbon folded steel rewards simple mindful care with generations of razor sharpness.

settings.title: 1,700+ Verified 5-Star Reviews
settings.copy: Collectors, culinary chefs, and outdoor field guides share their bench experiences.

settings.title: First Light on New Forged Drops
settings.copy: Restocks, one-of-a-kind Damascus billets, and VIP collection drops — delivered directly from our California atelier once a month.
